claim: Shared human-like gloss judgments across two frozen models, including deviations from physical ordering.
cohort: 3849 images excluding the 39 original matching-development images. Prior Qwen pilot images remain; not a new confirmatory cohort.
new_analysis: Descriptive within-physical-level Spearman correlations (all levels retained); pooled Pearson association after subtracting the mean within each exact physical-c level. Residual association CI uses 2000 crossed shape/illumination bootstrap draws, refitting weighted physical-level means in every draw.
gallery: Human empirical thirds versus equal-width physical-c thirds. Two examples nearest each cell center in the two rank coordinates, preferring distinct shapes. No model-agreement filter. Cell counts and median model percentile ranks use all images.
conflict_example: First archived discordant pair by pair_id for which both models choose the human-preferred stimulus in both presentation orders, with both images in the common cohort; explicitly illustrative. Overall inference uses all 1000 conflict pairs.
scope: Post-hoc reanalysis of existing image-level means, not human participant inference. No new responses collected.
